title: Build the page from what the rep said: transcript into the composer, composer open on arrival, Build page after recording
recommendation: Attach the take's transcript as a removable chip in the composer, open the composer with one question ("Who is this video for?") when the editor is reached from the recorder, rename the finish-screen action to "Build page", and land PR #1423 first so the transcript is there within two seconds of Stop instead of about thirty.

questions.q: Does the rep answer one question before the page builds, or does Build page run at once?
questions.recommended: Ask "Who is this video for?", but let an empty answer build from the transcript alone (the composer's existing default prompt for pasted sources).

questions.q: Should the rep see the transcript as a chip they can remove, or is it attached silently on the server?
questions.recommended: A visible "Transcript" chip in the composer, removable. The AI prompt already treats pasted sources as material, not instructions, so no prompt change is needed.

questions.q: Does PR #1423 (live transcript and title at Stop) land before this work?
questions.recommended: Yes. Measured on main the transcript is ready 28.9 s after Stop and the editor is open at 6.2 s; with #1423 the words are complete at Stop in 15 of 16 takes. Resolve its conflict with #1429 and give the 503 fallback a retry.

questions.q: What does the finish-screen button say: "Build page" (audit) or "Edit page" (U09 tonight)?
questions.recommended: "Build page", filled, with "Copy link" as the outline button. Tell U09 to drop its "Edit page" hunk.

questions.q: After Build, does the page publish itself, or does the rep publish?
questions.recommended: The rep publishes. The take page is already live from the grant with the video and title; Share should publish the built draft and copy the link in one click, with the dialog behind "Options".

questions.q: When the transcript is late or missing (non-English take, Workers AI 503), does Build wait or go without it?
questions.recommended: Go without it after five seconds and say so in the chip ("Transcript not available"). The rep can rebuild with "Edit with AI" once it lands.
